title: Renewal Orbit Segmentation Playbook (draft)
summary: Working draft: a compact, actionable segmentation sheet that maps customer signals to a simple three-orbit routing model for QBR prioritization and renewal playbooks. Includes scoring rubric, cadence guidance, playbook snippets, and routing rules for CSM/AM/SE handoffs.
content:
Purpose:
This doc is a working segmentation + routing sheet for QBR and renewal prioritization. Goal: reduce decision friction for which accounts get a full executive QBR, which get a lighter touch review, and which need an urgent renewal recovery plan.

Context / why another sheet:
- Current segmentation tools are scattered (spreadsheets, Notion pages, ad-hoc Slack threads). We need a compact score + playbook that CSMs can use during weekly renewal syncs.
- This is intentionally prescriptive: three "orbits" (A, B, C) map to cadence and playbooks. Orbit names are lightweight labels to make routing and handoffs consistent.

Segmentation dimensions (inputs for scoring):
- ARR / contract value band (numeric band): Small (S) / Mid (M) / Large (L) / Strategic (X)
- ICP fit (0-10): product-fit signals from solutions engineering (high = 9-10)
- Deployment mode (enum): hosted | dedicated | private
- Region (enum): NA | EMEA | APAC
- Usage health (0-10): daily active sessions, token throughput vs expected
- Latency/incident flags (binary): 0 = no recent incidents, 1 = incident in last 90d
- Billing / legal flags (binary): 0 = clean, 1 = billing/legal hold or dispute
- Expansion signal (0-5): open renewal opportunities or expansion requests in CRM

Scoring rubric (example weights):
- ARR band weight: S=1, M=2, L=4, X=6
- ICP fit weight: ICP_score (0-10) * 0.4
- Usage health weight: usage_score (0-10) * 0.6
- Deployment adjustment: dedicated/private +1 to risk sensitivity (i.e., more likely to be prioritized)
- Incident multiplier: if incident flag=1 then +3 risk points
- Billing/legal override: if billing/legal=1 -> emergency route (Orbit A emergency)

Example flattened scoring line (CSV style):
account_id,arr_band,icp,usage,deploy,region,incident,billing,expansion,score
ACCT-1023,L,8,6,hosted,NA,0,0,2, (4 + 8*0.4 + 6*0.6 + 0 + 0) => 4 + 3.2 + 3.6 = 10.8
ACCT-2145,X,9,4,private,EMEA,1,0,1, => 6 + 9*0.4 + 4*0.6 + +1 (private adj) +3 (incident) = 6 + 3.6 + 2.4 +1 +3 = 16

Orbit mapping (decision thresholds – adjust after 1 sprint of calibration):
- Orbit A (Executive / High-touch): score >= 14 OR billing/legal=1 OR high strategic tag. Cadence: weekly engagement + exec sponsor + 45–60m QBR prep.
- Orbit B (Standard QBR): score 9-13. Cadence: monthly CSM check-in, standard 30m QBR cadence during renewal window.
- Orbit C (Low-touch): score < 9. Cadence: automated renewal reminder, product ops enablement, quarterly light QBR only on request.

Playbook snippets by orbit (quick actionable steps):
Orbit A (what to do immediately):
- Triage: create CS-EMERGENCY ticket, notify AM and Solutions Eng via slack @channel and tag #cs-renewal-triage.
- Prep: CSM to run the "A-play QBR checklist" (attached as Quick Checklist below). Pull latency graphs, error-rate timeline, and a sample of failed requests.
- Engagement: schedule a 60m renewal workshop with exec sponsor, present remediation plan + timeline. Include cost/throughput tradeoffs (e.g., burst capacity options / dedicated capacity discussion).
- Escalation: if legal/billing present, loop in Legal and Finance and request a contract freeze hold until remediation steps are agreed.

Orbit B (standard QBR play):
- Prep: CSM runs standard QBR extraction (top usage trends, top prompts by cost, quality regressions if any). Attach the last 30-day latency/cost dashboard.
- Agenda: 1) health summary, 2) value metrics tied to feature adoption, 3) renewal timeline and options, 4) open action items and owners.
- Outcome: close or frame next steps; if score increases two consecutive weeks -> promote to Orbit A.

Orbit C (light touch):
- Automation: send templated renewal email 90/60/30 days out with link to self-service docs and cost optimization tips.
- Nurture: monthly product update digest. Escalate to Orbit B on trigger (usage drop > 50% month-over-month, or new support ticket frequency spike).

Routing rules and ownership matrix (short):
- Default owner: CSM assigned to account.
- Orbit A routing: CSM + AM + Solutions Eng + 1x quarterly SRE/Runtime contact (if incident-driven).
- Orbit B routing: CSM + AM optional + Product/Optimize consult for cost recommendations.
- Orbit C routing: CSM auto-notifications; engage SE only if requested.

Sample QBR checklist (A-play condensed):
- Data: last 90d latency, error spikes, token spend broken down by route/model, model/quantization variant used.
- People: identify exec sponsor, technical owner, procurement contact.
- Risks: list top 3 product/ops/legal risks and proposed mitigations.
- Commitment: request 1x remediation checkpoint within 14 days and publish an SLA-expectation doc for the client.

Triggers for orbit changes (automated or manual):
- Automated: sustained usage decline >50% (downgrade), incident severity >= Sev2 within 30d (upgrade), new large expansion opp in CRM (upgrade).
- Manual: CSM judgement call with AM approval; must be documented in ticket CS-CHANGE-<account>.

Operational notes for the team (implementation hints):
- Data sources: Billing exports (daily), Usage pipeline (kafka -> db), Support ticket tags (recent 90d), CRM renewal dates. Build a daily scoring job to surface orbit changes in #cs-dashboards.
- Playbook artifacts: add the A-play checklist as a template to Confluence and link from the account card.
- Slack conventions: use #cs-renewal-triage for immediate escalation, use emoji reactions for quick ack: :ring: for urgent, :white_check_mark: when resolved.

Open questions / TODOs (for next iteration):
- Calibration: run this rubric on last 6 months of closed renewals and tune thresholds/weights. Action: Liam to run dataset and produce calibration worksheet (JIRA: CS-4321).
- Region nuance: APAC timezone coverage – propose rotating CS on-call for APAC Orbit A windows. Action: Sofia to propose schedule.
- Integration: expose Orbit label in CRM account card (Salesforce/HubSpot) – product ticket required.

Appendix: quick template for an Orbit A kickoff email (copy/paste):
Subject: Redwood renewal workshop for <Account> — action items + remediation plan
Hi <ExecName> / <TechLead>,
Thanks for taking time to meet. We want to align on usage, recent incidents, and a concrete plan to ensure you hit your upcoming goals. Proposed agenda: 1) health snapshot, 2) remediation plan + timeline, 3) renewal options and commercial commitments.
Please confirm availability for a 60m session in the next 7 days.
Best,
<CSM name>

---
This doc is intentionally compact and intentionally "rough" — use it in weekly renewal syncs, iterate fast, and push changes back to Confluence after calibration.
